stories.headline: Ozlo’s Sleepbuds 2 build on Bose’s sleep earbud legacy
stories.dek: Ozlo’s first major update to its sleep earbuds introduces longer battery life, improved connectivity, enhanced audio, and new sleep features as the startup continues the product line once abandoned by Bose.

stories.headline: Can the New York Times Save Journalism From Our AI Overlords?
stories.dek: In 2023, the Times sued OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement. They’ve since spent more than $20 million on the case, and publisher A.G. Sulzberger has no plans to stop fighting it.

stories.headline: eBay reaches $56M settlement with e-commerce newsletter writers it terrorized in 2019
stories.dek: Ina and David Steiner inspired the ire of high-level eBay executives after occasionally criticizing the company in their newsletter. In 2019, a plot was concocted to intimidate the couple into halting their negative coverage.
